name: soft-start
description: A cozy, customizable VS Code welcome dashboard

softStart.accentColor.description: Dashboard accent color in #RRGGBB format. Soft Start adjusts the displayed color for contrast when needed.

softStart.panelOpacity.description: Dashboard panel opacity as a percentage.

softStart.artworkVisible.description: Show the dashboard background artwork when the window is wide enough.

softStart.artworkOpacity.description: Dashboard background artwork opacity as a percentage.

softStart.welcomeMessage.description: Welcome message shown on the dashboard.

softStart.headerKaomoji.description: Kaomoji shown in the dashboard header when decorative symbols are enabled.

softStart.decorativeSymbols.description: Show decorative symbols and the header kaomoji.

softStart.recentProjectsLimit.description: Number of recent projects shown on the dashboard. View all recent projects opens the full history.

enumDescriptions: Open in empty windows with no restored editor tabs.
Open at startup in all windows while preserving focus in restored editors.
Open only with the Soft Start: Open Dashboard command.
softStart.startupBehavior.description: When to open Soft Start automatically. Automatic opening requires the effective VS Code Startup Editor to be None.

softStart.projectsDirectory.description: Absolute path to the parent folder for new projects on the active VS Code host. Leave empty to choose a parent folder when creating a project.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:webview && npm run compile
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
